description: This file defines the Perl module Mail::Address, which provides functionality to parse, manipulate, and format email address strings, including extracting names, hosts, and users from email addresses. The module includes methods for parsing address strings, extracting names, and formatting address components.

classes.name: Mail::Address
classes.description: The primary class representing an email address, providing methods to parse, format, and extract components such as name, host, and user from email address strings.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new Mail::Address object with provided address components.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an email address string into its component parts (phrase, address, comment).

methods.name: phrase
methods.description: Gets or sets the phrase part of the address.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Gets or sets the email address.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Gets or sets the comment associated with the address.

methods.name: _extract_name
methods.description: Attempts to extract a person's name from a comment or phrase.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Retrieves the name component of the email address, derived from phrase or address.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Extracts the host (domain) part of the email address.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Extracts the user (local-part) part of the email address.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the address components into a proper email address string.
